check_in_zh: 今天练了吗？在 App 里点一下打卡。

dialogue.en: Alright, let's plan the sprint. We've got ten tickets in the backlog. Let's start with the Storm cutover one.
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.tip: cutover 指系统切换上线，重音在 cut
dialogue.zh: 好，我们来排这个 sprint。backlog 里有十个 ticket，先看 Storm 切换那个。

dialogue.en: That's the big one. I'd call it a 5-pointer. The migration is done, but the cutover has a lot of moving parts.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: moving parts 指多个关联环节；a 5-pointer 指 5 个 story point 的 ticket
dialogue.zh: 这是最大的一个，我估 5 个点。迁移做完了，但切换涉及很多环节。

dialogue.en: What are the moving parts, exactly? The network configs?
dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.zh: 具体是哪些环节？网络配置吗？

dialogue.en: Mostly, yeah. Plus we need to coordinate with the Ripple team on the switchover window.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: switchover window 指约定的切换时间段
dialogue.zh: 主要是。还得跟 Ripple 团队协调切换的时间窗口。

dialogue.en: So is 5 too small? Should we bump it to an 8?
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.tip: bump it to 提高到，口语里很常用
dialogue.zh: 那 5 个点是不是太小了？要不要提到 8？

dialogue.en: Honestly, 8 feels safer. I'd rather overestimate than get burned mid-sprint.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: get burned 指被坑、翻车，很口语；I'd rather...than... 宁愿……也不……
dialogue.zh: 说实话 8 更保险，我宁愿估多也不想 sprint 中途翻车。

dialogue.en: Agreed. If the cutover goes smoothly, we can always pull in more work.
dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.tip: pull in more work 拉更多活儿进来
dialogue.zh: 同意。如果切换顺利，我们随时可以再拉活儿进来。

dialogue.en: Okay, 8 points it is. Next: the Drova backfill for last week's data.
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.zh: 好，那就 8 个点。下一个：Drova 上周数据的回填。

dialogue.en: That's pretty straightforward. 2 points, and I can take it.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: straightforward 简单直接的；I can take it 我来接这个活儿
dialogue.zh: 那个比较简单，2 个点，我来接。

dialogue.en: Done. Anything anyone wants to flag before we lock this in?
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.tip: lock this in 指把计划定下来；flag 指出、提醒
dialogue.zh: 好。在锁定之前还有人要提醒什么吗？

dialogue.en: Just a heads-up, I'm out Friday afternoon, so keep that in mind for anything urgent.
dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.tip: heads-up 是提前告知，planning 必备表达
dialogue.zh: 提醒一下，我周五下午请假，紧急的事提前安排。

dialogue.en: Got it. Alright, the sprint is locked. Let's have a good one.
dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.zh: 收到。好，sprint 锁定了，加油。

key_phrases.note: call it 估点数，比 I think it's 更果断

key_phrases.en: The cutover has a lot of moving parts.
key_phrases.note: 解释为什么估点高，moving parts 是关键词

key_phrases.en: I'd rather overestimate than get burned mid-sprint.
key_phrases.note: 表达谨慎态度的地道说法
key_phrases.zh: 我宁愿估多也不想中途翻车。

key_phrases.en: Just a heads-up, I'm out Friday afternoon.
key_phrases.note: 提前告知安排，heads-up 很常用
key_phrases.zh: 提醒一下，我周五下午请假。

key_phrases.en: Anything anyone wants to flag before we lock this in?
key_phrases.note: 主持人收尾确认的标准句式
key_phrases.zh: 锁定之前还有要提醒的吗？

practice_zh: 跟读 5 分钟：打开 TTS，每句跟读 2 遍，重点练估点和 heads-up 的语调
背诵 5 分钟：遮住英文，只看中文说出英文
模拟 5 分钟：假装你是 planning 的参与者，用英文过一遍你手头的 ticket 并估点
roleplay_zh: 你是 planning 的参与者：挑一个你手头的真实 ticket，用英文讲清楚它要做什么、你估几个点、为什么这么估。
scene_zh: 每个 sprint 开始时的计划会，团队一起过 backlog、估点、定下这个 sprint 做什么。目标是让每个人对工作量达成共识，风险提前暴露。
title: Sprint Planning
